# Beycome FAQ

> Beycome is a flat-fee real estate platform for buying and selling homes without
> traditional agent commissions. Sellers list on the MLS for a $99 flat fee. Buyers
> can get up to 2% of the purchase price back at closing. Beycome Title handles fully
> remote closings. This FAQ is Beycome's help center and real estate knowledge base.

Operated by Beycome Corp., 7900 SW 57th Ave. Unit 23, South Miami, FL 33143.
Beycome Corp. is a technology platform, not a brokerage, and is not a licensed real
estate broker, mortgage lender or title insurer. Real estate brokerage, mortgage and
title services are provided by separate affiliated licensed entities.
Contact: contact@beycome.com · +1-804-656-5007

## Key facts

- Flat fee MLS listing: $99, one time, no listing agent commission.
- Listings syndicate to the local MLS, Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, Trulia and others.
- Buyer program: no upfront fee; up to 2% of the purchase price returned at closing, subject to lender approval.
- Beycome Title closes in Florida and Texas, and in Michigan, Ohio, Illinois and Indiana starting November 2, 2026.
- Beycome Title provides remote online closings with electronic signing.
